note: Add no-useless-fallback, a warning in the recommended config for a property's array in Emotion and vanilla-extract rules whose values are all strings every browser supports, so only the last fallback applies; it points to Devup UI's responsive arrays when breakpoints were meant. Arrays using var(), env(), vendor prefixes, newer viewport, container or line height units, newer color functions or clamp()/min()/max() are left alone, as are non-literal values, Devup UI shorthands and styled-components rules, which join the values with commas. No autofix.
